name: tend_press
description: Load a blank into the press fixture, start the cycle, wait until it is done, unload to the out pallet. Four parts.

source.made_by: written by hand as the 0.2 machine tending example, not from a demo

fixture.note: press fixture, 50 mm above the table

clear.note: safe waiting point outside the press

steps.label: wait for the press to finish

review: Example positions, sizes and signals, not measured on a real cell.
Check with the machine builder how cycle_done behaves: it must go off when a new cycle starts.
Top-down grip only: a chuck that needs a side grip is not supported yet.
No door or light-curtain signal in this example. A real press needs the safety design done by the integrator.
